# Devlonic Solutions

> Devlonic Solutions helps local service businesses in the US get more calls and booked jobs: website design and redesign, reputation management, Google Business Profile and local SEO, lead flows that send every enquiry to email and CRM, local ads and small automations. Every project has a fixed price agreed in writing before work starts. Founded and led by Muhammad Ahsan, a Top Rated developer on Upwork with 6+ years of experience and 100+ websites built.

## Key facts
- Contact: info@devlonics.com, +1 (773) 915-7523
- Who we work with: local service businesses only (HVAC, plumbing, roofing, cleaning, contractors and remodelers, landscaping, home care agencies and clinics)
- Service area: United States (remote team)
- Pricing: fixed quote per project or a fixed monthly fee for ongoing management, delivered in writing within one business day of a request; ad spend is paid to Google and Meta directly
- Process: written plan, approval, build on a staging site, launch, recorded walkthrough, 14 days of free fixes after launch
- Clients own their domain, website, Google Business Profile, ad accounts and leads

## Services
- [Website design and redesign](https://devlonics.com/services/website-design): Modern, phone-first websites for local service businesses, with tap-to-call, quote forms, reviews, service and town pages, and redirects so redesigns keep their rankings.
- [Reputation management](https://devlonics.com/services/reputation-management): Automatic review requests after every job, replies to every review, low-rating alerts and monitoring across Google, Yelp and Facebook, within Google's and the FTC's rules.
- [Google Business Profile and local SEO](https://devlonics.com/services/google-business-profile): Profile setup, optimization and weekly management, consistent business details, service-area pages and help with suspensions.
- [Lead generation and lead flow](https://devlonics.com/services/lead-generation): Quote funnels and preferred-time booking steps that send every lead to email, phone and CRM in seconds, including unfinished forms.
- [Local ads](https://devlonics.com/services/local-ads): Google Local Services Ads, Google search ads and Facebook and Instagram ads targeted to the service area, with call and conversion tracking.
- [Automation](https://devlonics.com/services/automation): Missed-call text-back, AI receptionists for after-hours calls, follow-ups, reminders and review requests.

## Case studies
- [Florida Surface Pro: quote funnel and lead flow](https://devlonics.com/work/florida-surface-pro): A WordPress quote funnel for a South Florida floor coating contractor that captures partial leads, asks for a preferred appointment time and sends every lead to email, a Google Sheet and Builder Prime CRM within seconds.
- [AI receptionist for an HVAC and plumbing company](https://devlonics.com/work/ai-voice-receptionist-home-services): A 24/7 VAPI voice receptionist that answers, books jobs and escalates emergencies, with call summaries posted to Slack.
- [Lead-to-install sales system for a solar installer](https://devlonics.com/work/hubspot-solar-sales-system): GoHighLevel to HubSpot migration, three pipelines, self-booked site surveys and coaching dashboards.
- [Google Ads reporting for a home improvement company](https://devlonics.com/work/ai-google-ads-reporting): Daily automated analysis that flags wasted spend and ranks fixes by impact.
- [Booking automation for a med spa](https://devlonics.com/work/med-spa-clickup-automation): Bookings, consent forms and reminders automated across two locations.
- [Clinic bookings on monday.com](https://devlonics.com/work/physiotherapy-monday-automation): Bookings, patient records and reminders for three physiotherapy clinics.

## Guides
- [Can't Hire Technicians? Build a Careers Page That Recruits](https://devlonics.com/blog/careers-page-hiring-technicians): Labor shortages hold back nearly a quarter of home service businesses. How a careers page on your website helps you hire technicians, with what to include.
- [Angi vs Thumbtack vs Your Own Website for Home Service Leads](https://devlonics.com/blog/angi-vs-thumbtack-vs-your-own-website): Shared leads, pay-per-lead costs and who owns the customer: how lead apps like Angi and Thumbtack compare with leads from your own website and Google profile.
- [Facebook Marketing for Home Service Businesses: What Works Now](https://devlonics.com/blog/facebook-marketing-home-service-business): Facebook is the second-biggest lead source for home service businesses after referrals. How to use pages, local groups, reviews and ads to bring in jobs in 2026.
- [Is Your Website Too Slow? Core Web Vitals for Small Businesses](https://devlonics.com/blog/core-web-vitals-small-business-website): Core Web Vitals measure how fast and stable your website feels. The three numbers that matter, the thresholds Google uses, and the fixes that make the biggest difference.
- [Service Area Pages That Rank (Without Looking Like Spam)](https://devlonics.com/blog/service-area-pages-seo): How to build service area pages for each town you serve that rank in Google and convert, without the copy-paste city pages Google calls doorway abuse.
- [Website Accessibility for Small Businesses: Avoiding ADA Lawsuits](https://devlonics.com/blog/ada-website-compliance-small-business): Over 2,000 website accessibility lawsuits were filed in the first half of 2025. What small businesses need to know, why overlays aren't a fix and a practical checklist.
- [3 Things Most Home Service Websites Are Missing](https://devlonics.com/blog/home-service-website-mistakes): Most home service websites skip service areas, business hours or an FAQ, according to a 2026 survey of 1,050 owners. Why each one costs calls and how to fix it fast.
- [Should a Home Service Business Show Prices on Its Website?](https://devlonics.com/blog/should-you-put-prices-on-your-website): Price is the top factor customers weigh when hiring a home service pro. When to show prices, ranges or starting prices on your website, and when a quote is better.
- [The FTC Fake Review Rule: What Small Businesses Can and Can't Do](https://devlonics.com/blog/ftc-fake-review-rule-small-business): The FTC's rule on consumer reviews took effect in October 2024. What it bans, what's still allowed and how home service businesses can collect reviews safely.
- [How to Get More Google Reviews (What Customers Expect in 2026)](https://devlonics.com/blog/how-to-get-more-google-reviews): Customers now want recent reviews, a 4.5-star rating and replies from the owner. How to get more Google reviews the right way, with the 2026 numbers that matter.
- [AI Search Is Changing How Customers Find Local Services](https://devlonics.com/blog/ai-overviews-local-search-service-businesses): Google AI Overviews and ChatGPT now answer many local questions before anyone clicks. What the data shows and how service businesses stay visible in AI search.
- [How to Redesign Your Website Without Losing Google Rankings](https://devlonics.com/blog/website-redesign-without-losing-seo): A website redesign can wipe out years of search traffic if URLs change carelessly. A step-by-step checklist based on Google's guidance and our own WordPress-to-new-site move.
- [Local Services Ads Are Moving Into Google Ads: A 2026 Checklist](https://devlonics.com/blog/local-services-ads-moving-to-google-ads): Google is moving Local Services Ads into Google Ads in phases through 2027. What transfers, what doesn't, and the checklist to run before your account migrates.
- [Google Now Charges for Missed Calls on Local Services Ads](https://devlonics.com/blog/google-local-services-ads-missed-calls): Since October 1, 2026, Google bills Local Services Ads for missed calls over 20 seconds during business hours. What changed, what it costs and how to stop paying for calls you never answer.
- [Speed to Lead: How Fast Home Service Businesses Must Reply](https://devlonics.com/blog/speed-to-lead-home-service-businesses): More than half of home service customers expect a reply within the hour. How fast you need to respond to calls, forms and texts, and how to get there without hiring.
- [Home Service Website Checklist: 15 Things That Bring In Calls](https://devlonics.com/blog/home-service-website-checklist): A practical checklist for HVAC, plumbing, roofing, cleaning and landscaping websites: the pages, features and trust signals that turn visitors into calls.
- [How Much Does a Small Business Website Cost in 2026?](https://devlonics.com/blog/how-much-does-a-small-business-website-cost): Small business website costs in 2026: DIY, freelancer and agency price ranges, monthly running costs, and the five factors that decide your quote.
- [Local SEO for Home Service Businesses: A 2026 Checklist](https://devlonics.com/blog/local-seo-checklist-home-service-businesses): A step-by-step local SEO checklist for HVAC, plumbing, roofing and cleaning companies: Google Business Profile, reviews, service-area pages and tracking.
- [What Is AEO? How to Get Recommended by AI Search](https://devlonics.com/blog/what-is-aeo-answer-engine-optimization): Answer engine optimization (AEO) explained: how ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and Perplexity choose businesses to recommend, and practical steps to show up.
